description: Na₄Al₃Si₃HO₁₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R3c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one H and four O atoms. The Na-H bond length is 2.40 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.44 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There is one shorter (2.44 Å) and three longer (2.45 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. All Al-O bond lengths are 1.76 Å. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra. All Si-O bond lengths are 1.64 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to three equivalent Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to four Na and one H atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom.
